1.animeTitle: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
1.description: Satoru Mikami is reincarnated as a slime in a fantasy world, gaining unique abilities and forging his own path as ruler of monsters.

2.description: Humanity lives inside cities surrounded by enormous walls protecting them from gigantic humanoid Titans that devour humans seemingly without reason.

episodes.title: To You, 2000 Years in the Future
That Day: The Fall of Shiganshina
The Night of the Closing Ceremony
Can't Look into His Eyes Yet
What Needs to Be Done Now

3.description: Tanjiro Kamado's life is shattered when demons slaughter his family. He joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure for his demon-turned sister Nezuko.

episodes.title: The Boar Bares Its Fangs, Zenitsu Sleeps
The House with the Wisteria Family Crest
You Must Master a Single Thing

4.description: Monkey D. Luffy, a boy who ate the Devil Fruit and gained rubber powers, sets sail with his pirate crew to find the legendary treasure One Piece.

episodes.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who's Gonna Be King of the Pirates!
The Great Swordsman Appears! Pirate Hunter, Roronoa Zoro
Morgan versus Luffy! Who's the Mysterious Pretty Girl?
Luffy's Past! The Red-Haired Shanks Appears!
Fear, Mysterious Power! Pirate Clown Captain Buggy!
Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs. Luffy!
Grand Duel! Zoro the Swordsman vs. Cabaji the Acrobat!
Who Is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!
The World's Greatest Weirdo! Here Comes Gaimon!
Clash! Combat Master Zoro vs. Ship Cook Sanji

5.description: Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed finger and joins the Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School to fight evil Cursed Spirits.

episodes.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event II
Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event III
The Origin of Blind Obedience II

6.description: Edward and Alphonse Elric use alchemy to search for the Philosopher's Stone to restore their bodies after a failed attempt to resurrect their mother.

episodes.title: One is All, All is One
The Arrogant Palm of a Small Human

7.description: Young Thorfinn grows up dreaming of adventure, but after his father is murdered by a Viking mercenary, he dedicates his life to revenge.

episodes.title: Beyond the Edge of the Sea
The Land on the Far Bank

8.description: Gon Freecss leaves his home to take the Hunter Exam, unaware of the danger and friendship that lies ahead in his search for his legendary hunter father.

9.description: Two and a half years after his training journey, Naruto Uzumaki returns home to Konoha to find his friends and face the Akatsuki threat.

10.description: In a world where most people have superpowers called Quirks, Izuku Midoriya is born without one — yet dreams of becoming the greatest hero.

episodes.title: What It Takes to Be a Hero
What I Can Do for Now
Yeah, Just Do Your Best, Iida!

11.description: 10,000 players are trapped in a virtual reality MMORPG — death in the game means death in real life. Kirito must clear all 100 floors to escape.

episodes.title: The Girl of the Morning Dew

12.description: Natsuki Subaru is summoned to a fantasy world with one peculiar ability — he returns to life after death with no one but himself retaining the memory.

episodes.title: Starting Life from Zero in Another World
The Morning of Our Promise Is Still Distant
I Cried, Cried My Lungs Out, and Stopped Crying

13.description: A thousand-year war between Soul Reapers and the Wandenreich Quincy begins, threatening to destroy the Soul Society and the world of the living.

14.description: Ken Kaneki narrowly survives a deadly encounter with a ghoul and wakes up to discover that he has become a half-ghoul, caught between two worlds.

15.description: After the events of Majin Buu, Goku and the Z-Fighters face new divine threats including the God of Destruction Beerus and reach power beyond Super Saiyan.

episodes.title: A Peacetime Reward! Who Gets the 100,000,000 Zeni?!
To the Promised Resort! Vegeta's Family Vacation
Where Does the Dream Pick Up? Find the Super Saiyan God!
Bid for the Dragon Balls! Pilaf and Crew's Impossible Mission!
Decisive Battle on King Kai's Planet! Goku vs. Beerus
Don't Anger the Destroyer! A Heart-Pounding Birthday Party
How Dare You Do That to My Bulma! Vegeta's Fury Explodes!!
Goku Steps Up! The Last Chance from Beerus-sama?!
Thanks for Waiting, Lord Beerus! A Super Saiyan God Is Born at Last!
Show Us, Goku! The Power of a Super Saiyan God!!

16.description: A spy codenamed Loid Forger must build a fake family for his mission — adopting a telepath girl and marrying an assassin — none knowing each other's secrets.

episodes.title: Show Off How In Love You Are
